title: Do these 5 every day this week, even on five hours of sleep
caption: Easy workout when you are tired: Glute Bridge, Lying Heel Slide, Wall Push-Up, Supported Sit-to-Stand, Seated Knee Lift. Easy on purpose, one or two slow rounds, about eight minutes on five hours of sleep. Save this for the next short night.

overlays.text: Do these 5 every day this week, even on five hours of sleep.

scenes.footer: Hinge. Easy on purpose. You stay lying down.

overlays.text: Glute Bridge. 10 reps. Lie on your back, feet flat, push your hips up.

scenes.footer: Core. Easy on purpose. Still on the floor.

overlays.text: Lying Heel Slide. 10 reps. On your back, knees bent, slide one heel out and back.

scenes.footer: Push. Easy on purpose. The wall takes most of it.

overlays.text: Wall Push-Up. 10 reps. Hands on the wall, lower your chest, press back.

scenes.footer: Squat. Easy on purpose. Your hands do some of it.

overlays.text: Supported Sit-to-Stand. 8 reps. Use your hands to help you up. Sit back down slowly.

scenes.footer: Core. Easy on purpose. You stay sitting down.

overlays.text: Seated Knee Lift. 10 reps. Sit tall on the chair, lift one knee, then the other.

scenes.footer: No pull this week. It comes back when you have slept.

overlays.text: One or two rounds, slow. About eight minutes. On five hours, that counts.

scenes.footer: Save this for the next short night.

overlays.text: How many hours did you get last night?
